meta.schema_notes: cpi_index is an INDEX value (e.g. 100, 250.3), NOT an annual inflation percentage. Do not enter 0.18 or 18 here. certificate_rate and cbe_rate_sanity_check are DECIMAL fractions: 0.18 = 18%. Do not enter 18. Gold/silver prices are Sabika reference prices in EGP. Silver is future-ready in the schema but is NOT a UI path in v1.

methodology.inflation: Annual average CPI index from official CPI data. Current CPI = latest published monthly CPI.
methodology.gold_price: Annual average Sabika reference 24k gram price in EGP from Sabika.app/internal Sabika historical pricing data. Current gold = current Sabika reference 24k gram price from Sabika.app.
methodology.silver_price: Annual average Sabika reference silver price in EGP from Sabika.app/internal Sabika historical pricing data. Current silver = current Sabika reference silver price from Sabika.app.
methodology.bank_certificate: Representative EGP certificate path based on the most relevant/flagship NBE and Banque Misr public certificates available during each year, annualized, assuming yearly reinvestment.
methodology.cbe_rate_sanity_check: CBE interest-rate data used internally as a sanity check only, not as the customer-facing certificate path.
